scope.admin_area: City of Houston, Texas, United States

coordinate_policy.local_measurement_crs_name: NAD83 / Texas South Central (US survey feet)
rules: Never interpret projected State Plane coordinates as longitude/latitude.
Never discard the source geometry when generating canonical WGS84 geometry.
Do not silently mix city limits, ETJ, postal city, and county boundaries.
Do not infer a building entrance, floor, room, or indoor position from a building footprint.
A representative point is not a legal boundary or a user's live GPS position.

feature_model.identity_rule: AO IDs are stable internal identifiers. Source IDs are retained as provenance and are not assumed permanent unless the source guarantees stability.

datasets.source_name: Harris County GIS - City of Houston Boundaries
datasets.filter_policy: Keep Full Service, Limited Service, and Pending separate. Pending is not current city limits.

datasets.note: ETJ is a separate jurisdictional geography, not part of the incorporated city boundary.

datasets.source_name: City of Houston COH Site Addresses
datasets.source_crs: service-native; inspect layer metadata before extraction
quality_notes: The City describes this as its most complete and official address repository.
The City also states that the compiled dataset requires ongoing cleanup.
Abandoned, preliminary, vacant, reverse-geocode, and other nonstandard statuses must be preserved, not silently treated as ordinary occupied addresses.

datasets.note: Enriched master address layer; compare with COH_SiteAddresses and deduplicate using source identifiers and normalized address, retaining source provenance.

quality_notes: City metadata says this layer is updated annually; the metadata search result reports an update on 2026-10-08.
The City warns it has no permanent unique ID. Do not use OBJECTID or PlusCode as a permanent AO feature identifier.
Reconcile intersections against road centerline topology before using them as graph nodes.

datasets.source_name: City of Houston Planning and Development / Public Works GIS
datasets.note: Do not substitute intersection points for street centerlines. OSM fallback must retain ODbL attribution and dataset date.

datasets.source_name: Harris County Appraisal District Public Land Parcels
datasets.note: Parcel boundaries are property geography, not building footprints and not city limits.

datasets.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL)
quality_notes: Statewide coverage; spatially filter to the Houston study boundary plus a documented buffer.
Footprints do not provide verified entrances, floors, or interior geometry.
Record the 2019-2020 imagery vintage; do not imply current building status.

datasets.source_name: Houston-Galveston Area Council LiDAR-derived building footprints
quality_notes: Derived from LiDAR classifications and may contain false or missing buildings.
The published service extent is limited; confirm feature coverage before treating it as citywide.

acquisition_policy.clip_extent: City of Houston legal boundary plus separately recorded buffer for edge continuity
validate: road network connectivity and grade separation
building footprint overlap and duplicate coverage
